uncertain_intervals.note: Ball above the image; hidden contacts cannot be verified.

method: Independent visual inspection of every third frame across the clip, then consecutive frames around contacts, before detector output. Approximate contact frames, not user-certified ground truth.
time_mapping: Initial OpenCV seek images matched to sequential PyAV frames by image difference; timestamps taken from decoded presentation timestamps.
reference_notes: The player independently confirmed exactly 26 touches in the conversation. Individual timestamps remain approximate visual labels.
